Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: A long pause stretches between the two of you. At several points, it seems that French Kweebec will blurt something out, but he never does; only when he shakes his head does he come up with a response.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: All of ma famille is back in France. We are not very close, but I would know if there is another Français on Kweebdrasil.

Line.Text: Is this something that he has told you ?

Choices.Text: He said that he's from Quebec. And so are you.
The best part is that I heard you're not even French.
